plan.title: Template Prefills and Technical Bulk Application

steps.note: Open the multi-stage project creation screen.
Provide the required event title using the runner's generated value.
Create the required Technical Stage and RFQ stages.
Choose the first predefined RFQ template offered.
Assert that the RFQ template was applied.
Verify that the RFQ template rendered product and quantity columns.
Add multiple products so the Technical Stage bulk-template behavior has more than one line item to cover.
Complete the RFQ sheet so its line-item cells are rendered and readable.
Assert that the first RFQ product cell is populated.
Assert that the first RFQ quantity cell is populated.
Assert that the second RFQ product cell is populated.
Assert that the second RFQ quantity cell is populated.
Use the Technical Stage template picker, which performs the RFP bulk-template action.
Assert that an RFP template is applied to the Technical Stage.
